About the Studio

Where Memories Meet History

Sunbreak Studio is a one-of-a-kind photography experience tucked inside Aquarium Village in Newport, Oregon. We specialize in old time photography — Wild West, Roaring 20s, and Victorian-era portraits that transport you to another time.

Whether you are a tourist looking for the perfect Oregon Coast souvenir, a family capturing a milestone, or a senior ready for your portrait — we bring the fun, the costumes, and the professional eye to make every photo unforgettable.

Don't miss our sister store, Coastal Chaos Art Gallery & Gift Shop, on Newport's historic bayfront at 602 SW Bay Blvd.
